{{Top|leg}}
A '''gyrocomputer''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] positioning system that was capable of sensing a vessel's location by analyzing a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] magnetic fields. It used gyroscopic technologies to located with pinpoint accuracy the ship's position in three dimensions.
